Благодарю вас за то, что установили Mall: Thank you for installing Mallet. It is a map editor for Garry's Mod and other Source engine games - completely free, with no subscriptions and no restrictions. This is demo version 0.1: it is still rough, it has bugs and loose ends, and it is released precisely so that it can be put to the test.
Я много лет работал в Hammer и хорошо зн: I worked in Hammer for many years and know well what people dislike about it: crashes with no autosave, a single undo for everything, texture search without previews, cryptic compile errors, leaks that take hours to find, and an interface unchanged since the 2000s. Грани браша не образуют замкнутый выпукл: The brush faces do not form a closed convex volume: VBSP will skip the brush or fail with an error. This is usually the result of the “Vertex” or “Clip” tools. It is recommended to delete the brush and rebuild it.
Браш выходит за пределы ±16384 юнитов, и: The brush extends beyond ±16384 units, and VBSP will stop with an error. Move the brush closer to the center of the map or delete it.
У браша больше 128 граней, VBSP не приме: The brush has more than 128 faces; VBSP will not accept it. Cut the brush into several parts (“Clip”) or replace it with a model.
У грани не задан материал, в игре она бу: The face has no material; in the game it will be black or invisible. The fix assigns the current material.
При масштабе 0 текстура растягивается бе: At scale 0 the texture stretches infinitely and VBSP reports an error. The fix sets the standard scale of 0.25.
У энтити не задан classname, и игра не с: The entity has no classname, so the game cannot create it. Delete the entity or set a class in its properties.
У точечной энтити не задан origin, игра: The point entity has no origin; the game will place it at 0 0 0. The fix writes the origin explicitly; then move the entity where it belongs.
Выход ссылается на имя, которого нет на: The output refers to a name that does not exist on the map and will have no effect. Check the target's targetname or remove the connection (the fix removes connections to nonexistent targets).
Объекты с одинаковым id приводят к ошибк: Objects with the same id cause errors in Hammer and in the editor. The fix assigns new ids to the duplicate objects.
Класса нет в FGD выбранной игры: энтити: The class is not in the FGD of the selected game: the entity will not appear in the game or will work incorrectly. Check the spelling of the class or select another game in the settings.
Класс точечный (с origin), но у энтити е: The class is a point class (with origin), but the entity has brushes. Select the brushes and run “Move to world” (Ctrl+Shift+W) or change the class to a brush class (func_*).
Класс брашевый, но у энтити нет брашей:: The class is a brush class, but the entity has no brushes: VBSP will skip it. Tie brushes to it (Ctrl+T) or change the class to a point class.
Файл VMT не найден в контенте игры, в иг: The VMT file was not found in the game content; in the game the face will be pink and black. The fix replaces the material with the current one across the whole map.
Файл MDL не найден в контенте игры, вмес: The MDL file was not found in the game content; a red ERROR sign will appear instead of the model. Choose another model in the entity properties.
Габариты игрока (32 × 32 × 72 от уровня: The player's bounds (32 × 32 × 72 from foot level) at this spawn point intersect a wall or floor: the player will get stuck or fall through. “Raise” places the point on the floor (End drops the selection onto the surface); move the point away from a wall manually. Sloped brushes are checked by their bounds, so false positives are possible.
Источник света находится внутри стены, п: The light is inside a wall, floor or ceiling: VRAD computes the light from inside the brush, and the room stays dark. “Push out” moves the light out of the brush through the nearest face. Sloped brushes are checked by their bounds, so false positives are possible.
Триггеры, кнопки и логические энтити дей: Triggers, buttons and logic entities act only through outputs, and this entity has none: firing it in the game will have no effect. Add a connection on the “Outputs” tab of the properties, e.g. OnTrigger → door_1 → Open.
На карте есть небо (tools/toolsskybox),: The map has sky (tools/toolsskybox) but no light_environment: VRAD will compute neither sunlight nor ambient sky light, and open areas will stay dark. “Add sun” places a light_environment above the player spawn point (pitch −60°).
VRAD учитывает только первый light_envir: VRAD uses only the first light_environment; the others do not affect lighting. Delete the extra ones or move their settings into the first.
Энтити находится вне всех брашей мира, в: The entity is outside all world brushes, in the void. VBSP will detect a leak through it: the map will not be sealed, VVIS will not run, and lighting will be flat. Move the entity inside the map or delete it (Ctrl+Alt+F moves the selection to the camera).
Прямоугольные браши мира с одинаковой те: Rectangular world brushes with the same texture touch each other along a whole face: a wall made of several blocks, a floor made of strips. Every extra brush adds faces and BSP cuts. “Merge” turns each such group into one brush in a single step (Ctrl+Z undoes); the texture is world-aligned and the scale is kept.
В Source дисплейсменты допустимы только: In Source, displacements are allowed only in the world: on a func_detail, door or trigger VBSP stops with the error “displacement found on a brush entity”. For a func_detail, “Return to world” moves its brushes to the world without offset (Ctrl+Z undoes). Move a displacement of any other entity to the world manually or replace it with a model.
Центр физического пропа (prop_physics, p: The center of a physics prop (prop_physics, prop_ragdoll) is inside a brush: when the map starts, physics pushes it out, and the prop jumps, flies away or gets stuck jittering. “Move out of brush” places the prop on the surface it is sunk into or moves it out through the nearest face (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Энтити привязаны друг к другу по кругу ч: Entities are parented to each other in a loop via parentname (A to B, B to A, or an entity to itself). The engine cannot determine the movement order: a warning is printed on load, the entities end up at the origin, or the game crashes. “Break loop” clears parentname on the first entity of the loop (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Отражающие материалы (вода, стекло, мета: Reflective materials (water, glass, metal, wet floors) take their reflections from the nearest env_cubemap. Without one they reflect black or the wrong sky - a common cause of “weird water”. “Add env_cubemap” places one cubemap above the player spawn point; a separate one is recommended for every room with such materials. After compiling, build the cubemaps in the Compile panel (buildcubemaps).
prop_static принимает только модели, соб: prop_static accepts only models compiled with $staticprop. With any other model VBSP prints “must be used on a dynamic entity” and removes the prop, so it will not be in the game. “Make prop_dynamic” changes the class to prop_dynamic with the same model, position and keys (Ctrl+Z undoes).
func_rotating и вращающиеся кнопки враща: func_rotating and rotating buttons rotate around their origin. If the origin is not set (then it is 0 0 0) or lies far from the brushes, the fan or wheel will move along a large circle in the game. “Center origin” places the axis at the center of the brushes (Ctrl+Z undoes).
info_overlay проецируется только на гран: info_overlay is projected only onto the faces listed in the sides key. If the overlay was moved or the wall under it was rebuilt, sides still holds the old face numbers, and the overlay disappears after compiling. “Update faces” writes the faces currently under the overlay into sides (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Имя энтити (targetname) содержит пробел,: The entity name (targetname) contains a space, comma or quotation mark. Source splits the output string on these characters, so outputs aimed at this name do not fire, and Hammer does not warn about it. “Fix name” replaces such characters with underscores on all entities with this name and updates all outputs and reference keys in a single step (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Выход вызывает вход, которого у цели нет: The output calls an input the target does not have: a typo (Toogle) or an input of another class (TurnOn on a door). The game silently drops such an event, and Hammer highlights the row only on this entity's outputs tab. If the target's FGD has a similar name, “Fix input” substitutes it into this connection (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Связь назначена на выход, который этот к: The connection is assigned to an output this class never fires: OnTrigger on a button (it has OnPressed) or a typo. Such a connection will never fire. If the FGD has a similar name, “Fix output” substitutes it (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Несколько одинаковых энтити (тот же клас: Several identical entities (same class, model, position, angles and name) are at the same point - usually after Ctrl+D or pasting without offset. In Hammer the duplicates are invisible, but in the game faces flicker, physics props fly apart on start, and the extra entities use up the limit. “Remove duplicates” keeps one entity (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Один и тот же браш (те же габариты и тек: The same brush (same bounds and textures) is repeated several times in one place - usually after Ctrl+D or pasting without offset. In Hammer this is invisible, but in the game faces flicker, and VBSP creates extra cuts. “Remove duplicates” keeps one brush in each place in a single step (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Прямоугольный браш смещён на долю юнита: A rectangular brush is offset by a fraction of a unit (fractional grid, scaling, an inserted prefab): its faces do not match the neighbours, gaps are visible in the game, and VBSP may detect a leak. The brush size is integer, so “Align to grid” moves it to the nearest integer coordinates - all found brushes in a single step (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Ступени, бордюры, колонны и мебель из бр: Steps, curbs, columns and furniture made of world brushes split the map into many visibility areas: VVIS takes longer, and culling in the game gets worse. Brushes up to 128 units in size should be made func_detail: they stay solid and visible but do not take part in the visibility calculation. “Make func_detail” applies this to all found brushes in a single step (Ctrl+Z undoes).
Карта использует более 80 % одного из ли: The map uses more than 80 % of one of the Source engine limits. If it is exceeded, VBSP will stop at the end of the compile with a MAX_MAP_… error. To keep headroom, merge small brushes, delete invisible ones, replace repeated elements with props, or split the map.
У модели нет физической оболочки (файла: The model has no collision mesh (.phy file), and a prop_physics without one is removed on spawn, so it will not be on the map. Choose a model with physics or click “Make prop_dynamic”: such a prop is stationary, is controlled by inputs and needs no physics.
У func_door_rotating не задана ось враще: The func_door_rotating has no rotation axis (an origin brush with the tools/toolsorigin texture or the origin key), so the door rotates around its center like a turnstile. “Axis at edge” places the origin at the end of the door's long side; if the axis should be on the other side, change the origin key.
